items.title: Missing INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES.SEARCH_(PARTITION_BY|ORDER_BY)
items.body:
These columns are missing in `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES`.
- `SEARCH_PARTITION_BY`
- `SEARCH_ORDER_BY`

In cloud-spanner-emulator v1.5.52:

```
spanner> DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES;
+---------------------+---------------+
| Column_Name         | Column_Type   |
+---------------------+---------------+
| TABLE_CATALOG       | STRING        |
| TABLE_SCHEMA        | STRING        |
| TABLE_NAME          | STRING        |
| INDEX_NAME          | STRING        |
| INDEX_TYPE          | STRING        |
| PARENT_TABLE_NAME   | STRING        |
| IS_UNIQUE           | BOOL          |
| IS_NULL_FILTERED    | BOOL          |
| INDEX_STATE         | STRING        |
| FILTER              | STRING        |
| SPANNER_IS_MANAGED  | BOOL          |
| SEARCH_PARTITION_BY | ARRAY<STRING> |
| SEARCH_ORDER_BY     | ARRAY<STRING> |
+---------------------+---------------+
```

In real instance:

```
spanner> DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES;
+--------------------+-------------+
| Column_Name        | Column_Type |
+--------------------+-------------+
| TABLE_CATALOG      | STRING      |
| TABLE_SCHEMA       | STRING      |
| TABLE_NAME         | STRING      |
| INDEX_NAME         | STRING      |
| INDEX_TYPE         | STRING      |
| PARENT_TABLE_NAME  | STRING      |
| IS_UNIQUE          | BOOL        |
| IS_NULL_FILTERED   | BOOL        |
| INDEX_STATE        | STRING      |
| SPANNER_IS_MANAGED | BOOL        |
+--------------------+-------------+
```

## Note
* These columns are not yet documented in https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/information-schema#indexes.
* Related: #330
